title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: Netanyahu falls short as Israel counts votes
preheader: Eisenkot's bloc trails as Arab parties' 16 seats could decide who governs.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Wednesday, October 28, 2026 — the 2 stories that matter most today, plus 3 updates on stories you're following and 4 quick items from around the world.

stories.story_title: Israel's election leaves Netanyahu's bloc short of a majority
stories.why_important: With more than half the votes counted, Netanyahu's right-wing bloc leads with about 56 seats and is short of the 61 needed to govern. Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc trails at about 48, while Arab parties hold 16 seats that could decide who becomes prime minister.
stories.what_overlooked: Arab communities reported ballot shortages and police disruptions on election day, Haaretz reported. That is a hurdle for parties whose seats may now decide the government.
stories.prediction: Official results, expected within days, will show which bloc can assemble 61 seats.

stories.story_title: Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases and spreads abroad
stories.why_important: Congo's Ebola outbreak has passed 10,000 confirmed cases and nearly 4,900 deaths. It is the fastest-growing outbreak on record, and cases have appeared in Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo virus driving it.
stories.what_overlooked: Attacks on health workers in Congo and their strike over unpaid wages are slowing the response, The Hindu reported.
stories.prediction: The WHO will decide within days whether to declare a broader emergency as cases are confirmed in Uganda and Kenya.

quick_hits.text: Finland's Stubb and Norway's Støre held a 'frank' call with Putin on ending the Ukraine war, drawing criticism from some EU leaders.
Taiwan's interior minister said police will step up efforts to stop China, gangs and local collaborators from meddling in the 2026 elections.
China's state broadcaster suspended Spanish league broadcasts and three Chinese brands dropped Kylian Mbappe over a remark about Mao Zedong.
A Foreign Policy analysis says the US-Iran war has cost 800 American casualties and pushed US inflation to its highest since 2023.

big_number.context: The cut in global emissions that current climate pledges would achieve by 2035, a UN report found, far short of what is needed.
